info.title: PATCH Vulnerability Management API
info.description: API for managing assets, vulnerabilities, and remediations in hospital environments

get.description: Get all assets. Any authenticated user can view all assets.

post.description: Create a new asset. The authenticated user will be recorded as the creator.

get.description: Get all assets affecting a specific device group. Any authenticated user can view all assets.
Get a single asset by ID. Any authenticated user can view any asset.

delete.description: Delete an asset. Only the user who created the asset can delete it.

patch.description: Partially update an asset. Only the user who created the asset can update it.

post.description: Create one or more new assets from an array. The authenticated user will be recorded as the creator.
Synchronize Assets on VIPER from a partnered platform

get.description: Get all vulnerabilities. Any authenticated user can view all vulnerabilities.

Get a single vulnerability by ID. Any authenticated user can view any vulnerability.

delete.description: Delete a vulnerability. Only the user who created the vulnerability can delete it.

put.description: Update a vulnerability. Only the user who created the vulnerability can update it.

post.description: Create one or more new vulnerabilities from an array. The authenticated user will be recorded as the creator.
Synchronize Vulnerabilities on VIPER from a partnered platform

get.summary: Get Device Group SBOM from Helm
get.description: Get a single SBOM via Helm using the helmSbomId. Any authenticated user can pull a Device Group's SBOM.

put.summary: Update Device Group Helm SBOM ID
put.description: Update only the helmSbomId field on a given Device Group.

get.summary: List all versions of an artifact
get.description: Get all versions of an artifact, ordered by version number.

post.description: Upload a new artifact version, which becomes the latest artifact. Updates version chain pointers accordingly.

get.description: Get a single artifact by ID.

put.description: Update artifact metadata (name, artifactType, size only). Only the user who created the artifact can update it.

get.description: Returns network flow topology data according to schema
Fetch a single work-order ticket with linked entities, sub-tickets, and comments.

patch.description: Partially update a work-order ticket. Any omitted field is left untouched. Pass null on nullable fields (assigneeId, scheduledAt) to clear them. Pass an empty array on departmentIds to clear all departments. `descriptions` replaces the per-department description set wholesale; entries with empty bodies are dropped, and removed departments lose their descriptions automatically.

get.description: Return a paginated set of work-order tickets matching the given filters, with linked entities (assets, vulnerabilities, remediations) included.

post.summary: Attach an asset to a work-order ticket
post.description: Link an existing asset to the given work-order ticket via the many-to-many relation. Returns the updated ticket detail.

delete.summary: Detach an asset from a work-order ticket
delete.description: Unlink an asset from the given work-order ticket. The asset itself is not deleted. Returns the updated ticket detail.

post.summary: Add a comment to a work-order ticket
post.description: Post a comment authored by the authenticated user. Bumps the ticket's lastCommentAt in the same transaction.
Synchronize Work Order tickets on VIPER from a partnered platform
